questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Low level. Was very surprised with the difference. Not very default and didn't feel like an academic institution but more like an extension to high school.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Basic. There wasn't expected a lot from the students and likewise not a lot expected og the teachers.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: International Organizations, The Political Systems of Maghreb, Political and Juridical system og the EU, Comparative Politics, Sociology of Migration and Population.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Sociology of Migration and Population. Exciting topic in it's own and the professor was good ad teaching.
